Changelog

ohseer 0.1.0

New OCR providers

  • olmOCR (AI2): open-weights vision-language model served over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepInfra, Parasail, Cirrascale, or a local vLLM server). Configure with OLMOCR_API_KEY and OLMOCR_SERVER. Adds olmocr_ocr() and olmocr_extract_pages().
  • Chandra (Datalab): hosted academic-document OCR API with strong tables and equations and figure extraction. Configure with DATALAB_API_KEY. Adds chandra_ocr() and chandra_extract_pages().
  • dots.mocr (rednote-hilab): local multilingual layout vision-language model served by your own vLLM server. Configure with DOTSMOCR_SERVER (defaults to http://localhost:8000/v1). Adds dotsmocr_ocr() and dotsmocr_extract_pages().

All three are selectable through the unified ohseer_ocr() interface (including provider fallback) and return the shared Tensorlake-compatible per-page format.

Improvements

  • Chat-based providers now use ellmer for the LLM plumbing: Claude via chat_anthropic() with type_*() structured output, olmOCR via chat_openai_compatible(), and dots.mocr via chat_vllm(). The bespoke OCR REST APIs (Mistral, Tensorlake, Chandra, Textract) continue to use httr2 directly. Claude’s structured output is requested with convert = FALSE, preserving the existing per-page output contract.
  • Fixed the package author/citation metadata so citation("ohseer") credits Nathan Layman (ORCID 0000-0003-2238-6584).

Dependencies

  • Added ellmer (>= 0.4.0) to Imports.
  • Removed the now-unused base64enc dependency.
